notes.title: Incognito Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Good news everyone, we've got an update![/h1]

[list]
[*] We've added incognito browsers to VR Toolbox, which are added to the scene using Add Screens and selecting the new incognito browser icon. You'll know you are on an incognito window if the edge glows magenta when brought in focus. 

[*] We've added new icons for the screen selector, which are now much clearer and easy to interpret. 

[*] The new Prop Selector has been added to the Tutorial.

[*] First-time users on Steam will get a "Getting Started" page to help them get set up and better understand how VR Toolbox works.
[/list] 

[i]We've identified an issue where the prop selector persists when transitioning to the 360 theater view from a YouTube 360 link. This will be fixed in the next update.[/i]

notes.title: Major Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings VR Toolbox Community![/b]

We have some great news in this wrap-up of recent updates! We’ve got some new features, upcoming content, and some great new stuff from the community. 

[b]What’s New?[/b]
VR Toolbox has gotten a lot of great features recently! 
 - The UI window has been upgraded with a new font and some additional style. 
 - We’ve expanded plugin support, which we have a guide for on the Steam page. 
 - We have a new Clock that is featured in Add Props → Widgets, to help keep an eye on the time while you work. 
 - We’ve also added some colored light orbs to brighten up the scene, and they utilize a new flag for props that keeps flat images facing forward like old-school sprites which anyone can apply to their own custom props. 
 - We’ve added the ability to add your own custom cube .dds files for a custom 360 background. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26253312/3de78bf63088a89e470662a229ddce7b512932e3.jpg[/img]


[b]Coming Soon[/b]
We’re excited to announce the upcoming Cartoon Forest Props DLC for Steam! This scene provides a cozy place to watch videos, play games, or get work done, complete with a new 360 Background, new Cartoon Forest Default Scene, and 11 new props! This will be releasing very soon, and is exclusive to Steam for now.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26253312/7aeb68a31b627a591cab1219b6252df5ababc736.jpg[/img]


[b]Community Spotlight[/b]
We want to highlight two amazing members of our community. Stryder and Biohazred have been showing us what a true VR enthusiast can to with the power of VR Toolbox, and we’re happy to share their exceptional work with everybody!

Stryder has been in great contact with us regarding desired features and input on what we have, and has written guides for how to get the most out of your Steam puck http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1126746747 and a way to create a personalized launchpad for all your VR apps http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1087803587!

Biohazred has been making an awesome Halo scene for his own personalized gaming experience, and it is looking absolutely amazing! Check out the progress here: https://www.facebook.com/100013557163534/videos/327954754333094/

Cheers, folks!

notes.title: YouTube 360 Update
notes.notes:
YouTube changed their 360 encoding and for a while we didn't play some videos correctly. We have implemented the new formats and VR Toolbox should automatically detect them except for one.

If a video doesn't appear to play correctly, try changing the 180/360/SBS/OU/Cube settings. Most likely Cube => Stereo will fix it.

notes.title: 3/6/17 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New/Updated Features[/h1]
- New post-processing filters added for Contrast, Sharpness, White Balance, and Vignette.
- Added prop collisions with the environment while they are being spawned.
CTRL+SHIFT+Plus/Minus resizes anything in gaze that is not locked.
- UI appearance updated. 

[h1]Experimental New Movement Features[/h1]
- CTRL+SHIFT+Arrow Keys to move around the environment!
- Teleport by double-tapping the Menu button => Actions, then aiming at a destination and selecting Teleport.

[h1]Smooth Recording Mode[/h1]
- CTRL+SHIFT+F11 activates smoothing for the Left eye, allowing cleaner mirror-to-screen recordings.
*WARNING: This requires you to close your left eye as it is getting a stabilized feed.*

notes.title: LightVR Release
notes.notes:
After spending a couple months on Early Access, we are now releasing LightVR with many new features and props.

Enjoy our new product and we are looking forward to your feedback. We are actively improving the features, as well as adding more art assets. If you encounter a problem, please describe it in the discussions page and we'll address it. Make sure to check the beta branch, which has the latest updates (but might be a bit unstable).
